messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: Hi Erkki! trn 87 had its SFP changed, link up, optics normal, counters zero. But traffic is still not flowing.

messages.author: Erkki Expert
messages.text: Moi Veikko. Let me check the port status from my side. Yes, physical link is up but protocol is down.

messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: Should I try to reboot the whole box or maybe swap the SFP again?

messages.author: Erkki Expert
messages.text: No, disable the interface, wait a bit, enable it again; don't reboot it and don't swap the SFP again.

messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: Okay, I will toggle the port admin status now. Waiting a few seconds...

messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: Done on TRN087, traffic is back. Looks like it did the trick! :)

messages.author: Erkki Expert
messages.text: Great, I see the interface is fully up and traffic is running fine. We are good to go.
